workload.collection: run_traced recorder and default reducers; heavy collection disabled

method: Call existing run_stock/run_traced directly, bypassing only the checker main that aligns stock batch to 1. Observe HFLM _model_generate input shapes and _detect_batch_size calls with forwarding wrappers; no arithmetic or generation settings changed. Each run retains full results and samples.

gsm8k.revision_note: Not recorded in cached dataset metadata. Split fingerprints and full evaluated documents, targets and prompt hashes are retained; original upstream revision is not asserted.

triviaqa.revision_note: Not recorded in cached dataset metadata. Split fingerprints and full evaluated documents, targets and prompt hashes are retained; original upstream revision is not asserted.

what: Generation batch verification: separate recorder parity at actual batch 1 from stock batching effects. This is a bounded 32-document experiment, not full-dataset generation verification.

protocol_details.equality_tolerance: none: exact string and numeric equality
protocol_details.runtime_observation: forwarding wrappers on HFLM._model_generate and HFLM._detect_batch_size; no generation arguments, tensors or return values altered

findings: All 12 stock batch-1 versus traced requested 1/8/auto comparisons agree exactly on raw generation, filtered response and aggregate metrics (32 documents each; 576 document/filter comparisons).
All traced generation calls use actual batch 1, regardless of requested 1, 8 or auto. Each auto run probes exactly once.
Stock batch 1 versus 8 differs on 22/32 and 6/32 raw generations for SmolLM2 gsm8k and triviaqa, and 17/32 and 6/32 for Qwen3 gsm8k and triviaqa. Inputs are identical.
Qwen3 gsm8k strict-match and flexible-extract both change from 0.46875 (15/32) at stock batch 1 to 0.4375 (14/32) at batch 8. All traced settings retain 0.46875.
Stock auto resolves to actual batch 8 for SmolLM2 and 1 for Qwen3 on both tasks in this environment. Auto is not a fixed batching condition.
limitations: Only two models and the first 32 documents per task; no claim about all architectures, datasets or batch sizes.
Heavy collection features were not rerun. Default recorder/reducers are enabled in traced runs. Existing heavy collection evidence is separate.
GPU bfloat16 only. No CPU result is used as GPU correctness evidence.
Runs use the internal package, whose Python source files were verified byte-identical to public release-1.1.0; this session did not rebuild or reinstall the wheel.
Raw experiment files and driver are preserved in an ignored parity directory; only the reduced measurements JSON is currently untracked for review.
Upstream dataset revisions were unavailable from cache metadata; fingerprints and evaluated inputs are preserved.
Wall times include model/task setup, auto probing and metric aggregation, and are not a controlled performance benchmark.
Stock batch differences establish batch sensitivity; this experiment does not isolate which numerical kernel or padding effect caused each changed token.
